author_or_account: CIVICUS: World Alliance for Citizen Participation
title: Youth activism, decentralized organizing, and protest capture
discussion_signal: The post describes youth-led movements as fast, digital, and decentralized, while warning that protest openings can be captured by elites, traditional parties, or military actors. It links mobilization to the later question of who controls the outcome.
linked_research_question: When networked mobilization opens a political opportunity, what carries action into representation, institutional response, or elite capture.
limits: Global movement framing rather than a measured US campaign
Institutional post and selected professional audience
